press-black.$description: Press Black — Primary text, headings, button borders, backgrounds of dark sections — the near-black with a warm brown undertone that prevents harshness and reads as ink rather than void

voltage-yellow.$description: Voltage Yellow — Primary CTA buttons and nav 'Iniciar gratis' — one saturated hit of color on an otherwise near-monochrome page; impossible to miss without competing for dominance

teal-ink.$description: Teal Ink — Links, icon fills, image accents — muted teal provides navigational contrast against warm-neutral backgrounds without reading as a generic blue

warm-parchment.$description: Warm Parchment — Section backgrounds for GDPR and feature callout bands — warm cream that reads as aged newsprint, warmer than gray

sand-footer.$description: Sand Footer — Footer background — deeper gold-tan that anchors the page base with warmth

ash-white.$description: Ash White — Card backgrounds, secondary section fills

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page backgrounds, card surfaces, reversed text on dark sections

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, captions, supporting copy

warm-charcoal.$description: Warm Charcoal — Tertiary text, card body copy on white surfaces

silver-rule.$description: Silver Rule — Borders, dividers, input underlines in secondary contexts

true-black.$description: True Black — Input text, icon fills, certain border overrides at maximum contrast

graphik-web.$description: All UI text: nav, buttons, body copy, captions, badges, inputs, card text. Weight 400 is default body; 500 for subheadings and emphasis; 700 sparingly for bold callouts. The tight -0.013em letter-spacing across all sizes gives even small text a compressed editorial density.

means-web.$description: Display headlines and hero headings only. Weight 300 at 40-48px is the signature move — most SaaS headlines use 600-800, but this light-weight serif whispers authority at large scale. The -0.021em tracking at display sizes compresses letterforms into a tight, journalistic headline block.
